segments.text:
V. 10.
Then ſhall many be offended—So as utterly to make ſhipwreck of ſaith and a pure conſcience. But hold ye faſt Faith (ver. 11.) in ſpite of falſe Prophets: Love, even when Iniquity and Offences abound (ver. 12.) And Hope, unto the End (ver. 13.) He than does ſo, ſhall be ſnatched out of the Burning. The love of many will wax cold—The Generality of thoſe who love GOD, will (like the Church at Epheſus, Rev. 2, 4.) Leave their firſt love.
